'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] located in {{Location|Egla Town}}. He only appears in the Open-World after the completion of {{Quest|The Last Knight}}.

He aimed to become a true knight, inspired by the knight he met in his childhood. Despite learning the knight he met wasn't a true knight, he remains steadfast in his knights oath.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Carlow:''' What truly defines a knight?
:;'''Carlow:''' Humility, justice, valor... Are these virtues reserved only for those with a title?
:Carlow seems deeply focused and hasn't noticed your arrival.
:{{DIcon}} Hello there!
::'''Carlow:''' Hello there, {{Rover}}! Hope you're having a wonderful day today!
:{{DIcon}} Startle him.
::'''Carlow:''' Waaah...
::'''Carlow:''' Oh, it's you, {{Rover}}! You startled me for a moment there. Sorry, I was just so focused that I didn't notice.
:::{{DIcon}} What were you pondering just now?
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Let's leave him to himself
:'''Carlow:''' I was just wondering if Egla Town could still hold the Night Reveries in the future.
:'''Carlow:''' Of course, I don't mean locking the doors every night... I just think we should showcase the knightly plays as a part of the festival celebrations.
:'''Carlow:''' Perhaps it doesn't match the grandeur of the plays at the [[Carnevale]], but these are stories lived by the people of Egla Town.
:'''Carlow:''' In a way, it's a testament to all the knights that came before.
{{Dialogue End}}
